Subject: Velocity Health — proposed MAP + performance acceptance criteria (draft)

Hi Samir / Jenna,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — appreciated the pragmatic questions from your ML team. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that bundles the procurement steps, evaluation milestones, and the performance acceptance gates we discussed. High level:

- Week 0: Legal & procurement kickoff (DocuSign link in the MAP)
- Week 1: Private test deployment + credentials provisioned
- Week 2: Evaluation run (see eval-plan-stepwise.md) including TTFT and streaming scenarios
- Week 3: Acceptance window and canary rollout planning

Performance acceptance (we want this explicit in the MAP):
- TTFT (cold start to first token) target: p50 <= 180ms, p95 <= 420ms, p99 <= 900ms for chat median prompt size (approx 150 tokens).
- Streaming steady-state latency (token emit): p50 <= 12ms, p95 <= 30ms, p99 <= 60ms at target concurrency.
- Concurrency target for acceptance: sustained 150 concurrent chat sessions with 6 tokens/sec average per session.
- Throughput: baseline throughput >= 80k tokens/min across the Dedicated pool during acceptance windows.

I attached the MAP (redwood-map-v1.pdf) and a short csv with the sample workloads we intend to run (velocity-ttft-sample-results.csv). Evelyn has a more detailed eval plan in the follow-up below.

Next steps (can we lock dates?):
- Can you confirm procurement point-of-contact (procurement@velocityhealth.com) and an internal QA owner?
- If the performance targets above look reasonable, we'll finalize the MAP and schedule the private test cluster for Week 1.

Thanks — look forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Karthik,

Thanks — this is helpful and much clearer than the high-level deck. A few notes from our side before we lock dates:

1) The TTFT numbers look reasonable but we need to confirm how you measure p99 (combined network + compute? or compute-only?). We run in a cloud region with variable network; for procurement we need the conservative end-to-end numbers.
2) For streaming latency please also capture inter-token jitter (we care about p95 of token-to-token gaps during sustained generation).
3) Can you provide a short acceptance protocol we can hand to QA? It should include exact payload sizes, prompt mix, and the load schedule.

Procurement contact is procurement@velocityhealth.com (cc'd). QA owner will be Jenna — she will coordinate the in-house runs.

If you can get the eval plan and a compute-inclusive timing breakdown by EOD tomorrow, we'll try to target Week 1 provisioning.

Hi all — jumping in with the technical acceptance plan and the exact protocol for QA. I attached eval-plan-stepwise.md to the MAP but pasted the important pieces below so it's easy to hand to your QA team.

Evaluation protocol (compute-inclusive):
- Measurement definition: TTFT (Time to First Token) measured from request send time at client to first byte of generated token arriving at client socket. This includes network egress and ingress along a realistic path; we will run one test with the customer in their VPC to capture identical networking.
- Hardware: Dedicated pool of A100s (mixed 80GB + 40GB) with quantization profile q3/8. We'll share instance IDs in the private test cluster.
- Workload mix (attached csv): 60% short chat (avg 40 tokens), 30% medium (150 tokens), 10% long (400 tokens).
- Load schedule for acceptance window: ramp 0->150 concurrent sessions over 10 minutes, hold for 20 minutes, then a 10-minute spike to 250 concurrent sessions to validate graceful degradation/fallback.
- Streaming config: streaming response chunking at 4 tokens per emit; measure token-to-token delta. Jitter metric = 95th percentile of inter-token gap.
- Metrics we will report: TTFT p50/p95/p99, token emit p50/p95/p99, sustained throughput (tokens/min), error rate (5xx/4xx), and observed KV cache hit rate.

Preliminary local-run numbers (dev rig, not acceptance):
- TTFT (dev rig, small prompt): p50 120ms, p95 260ms, p99 520ms
- Token emit (steady): p50 9ms, p95 24ms, p99 48ms
- Notes: dev rig uses colocated network; we expect +30–40ms for conservative e2e numbers in a default cloud region.

Deliverables for Week 1:
1) Private test cluster credentials and a single-run smoke test (3 test prompts) — Day 1
2) Full acceptance run with logs, nyc-style traces, and per-request TTFT breakdown — Day 7
3) Acceptance report and canary checklist — Day 10

I'll own the test execution and results artifact. Samir/Jenna — if you want, we can schedule the first run with your QA in your VPC; that will give the cleanest end-to-end numbers.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

Attachments: eval-plan-stepwise.md (detailed steps), velocity-ttft-sample-results.csv
